Sara (ops): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners and deadlines for the customer-facing items: status page copy update, public incident summary, and whether/when to share the full RCA with customers. Also want an action to detect recurring patterns.

Mike (eng): I'll own status page copy & short summary. Can have draft by EOD Wed. @Kate can you review for tone?

Kate (product): Yep. I'll review and handle approvals with Legal. Draft timeline OK?

Lucas (support): I'll compile list of affected customers and prepare targeted comms once we have approved wording. ETA Thu morning.

Jamie (observability): I'll run the recurrence checks and add an alert/dashboard if this is a pattern. Need until Fri COB to finish analysis.

LegalBot: FYI — for external RCAs we need to run the customer data review. If no customer-sensitive data is involved, Legal can sign off within 48 hours of a draft.

Mike (eng): Draft status page copy idea:

```
We experienced degraded API latency between 2024-12-05 01:12 UTC and 01:38 UTC due to a batching regression. Service is restored. We will publish a detailed incident summary and steps we're taking to prevent recurrence.
```

Thoughts?

Kate (product): Good start. Two small edits: remove the word 'regression' -> use 'deployment issue' and add "A link to the full postmortem will be provided once published."

Sara (ops): Approvals needed: Legal, Support lead, and Product. Who blocks?

LegalBot: I'll review once Kate tags me. Expect 24-48 hours.

Lucas (support): Support lead @Nina (not in thread) is fine with this approach; I'll loop her in.

Jamie (observability): On the recurrence point — I see similar latency spikes on 3 separate dates last quarter. I'll include that analysis in the RCA and recommend an anomaly rule: p95 latency > X ms for 3/5 windows triggers pager + runbook.

Sara (ops): Action items (assigning owners and timelines):
- Mike: status page draft by Wed EOD
- Kate: review + tag Legal by Thu
- Lucas: customer list and targeted comms by Thu AM
- Jamie: recurrence analysis + alert + dashboard by Fri COB
Please ack with :white_check_mark: and flag if timelines need adjusting.
